main:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads test cases from standard input, computes the maximum size returned by the recurse helper on the original integer array, on every single-deletion array, and on every double-deletion array, then prints the result per test case as 'Case #iii: max'." main]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> args </REF>: String[] "Command-line arguments; not used by the method."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Set up a Scanner named input over System.in using InputStreamReader and BufferedReader. RESULT input]
            [COMMAND Read the next line from input and parse it as the integer t, the number of test cases. RESULT t]
            [COMMAND For each test case index iii from 1 to t inclusive: RESULT test_case_loop]
            [COMMAND Within the test case loop, read the next integer n from input as the current array length. RESULT n]
            [COMMAND Within the test case loop, allocate an int array aw of length n and reset the global/field table to a new ArrayList<ArrayList<Integer>> containing one empty ArrayList. RESULT aw_and_table]
            [COMMAND Within the test case loop, for each index i from 0 to n-1 inclusive: read the next integer into aw[i] and append a new empty ArrayList to table. RESULT aw_populated]
            [COMMAND Within the test case loop, for each index i from 1 to n inclusive: call recurse(aw, i) and store the returned list at table index i using table.set(i, ...). RESULT table_original]
            [COMMAND Within the test case loop, initialize max to the size of the list at table index n. RESULT max]
            [COMMAND Within the test case loop, for each single-deletion index i from 0 to n-1 inclusive: RESULT single_deletion_loop]
            [COMMAND Within that single-deletion loop, reset table to a new ArrayList<ArrayList<Integer>> containing n empty ArrayLists. RESULT table_single_reset]
            [COMMAND Within that single-deletion loop, build int[] aww of length n-1 containing all elements of aw except the element at index i. RESULT aww_single]
            [COMMAND Within that single-deletion loop, for each index ii from 1 to n-1 inclusive: call recurse(aww, ii) and store the returned list at table index ii using table.set(ii, ...). RESULT table_single]
            [COMMAND Within that single-deletion loop, set tempmax to the size of the list at table index n-1; if tempmax exceeds max, set max to tempmax. RESULT max]
            [COMMAND Within the test case loop, for each pair of deletion indices i from 0 to n-1 inclusive and j from i+1 to n-1 inclusive: RESULT double_deletion_loop]
            [COMMAND Within that double-deletion loop, reset table to a new ArrayList<ArrayList<Integer>> containing n-1 empty ArrayLists. RESULT table_double_reset]
            [COMMAND Within that double-deletion loop, build int[] aww of length n-2 containing all elements of aw except the elements at indices i and j. RESULT aww_double]
            [COMMAND Within that double-deletion loop, for each index ii from 1 to n-2 inclusive: call recurse(aww, ii) and store the returned list at table index ii using table.set(ii, ...). RESULT table_double]
            [COMMAND Within that double-deletion loop, set tempmax to the size of the list at table index n-2; if tempmax exceeds max, set max to tempmax. RESULT max]
            [COMMAND Within the test case loop, print 'Case #' + iii + ': ' + max to standard output. RESULT printed_line]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: If the first call to input.nextLine() finds no line available.]
        [LOG "Reading the test count t fails before the main processing loop begins."]
        [THROW NoSuchElementException "The first line of standard input is missing, so t cannot be read."]
    [END_EXCEPTION_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: If the first call to input.nextLine() returns text that is not a valid integer literal.]
        [LOG "Reading the test count t fails before the main processing loop begins."]
        [THROW NumberFormatException "The first line of standard input is malformed, so t cannot be parsed as an int."]
    [END_EXCEPTION_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: If any call to input.nextInt() inside the test case loop finds no token available.]
        [LOG "Reading an array size or an array element fails while processing a test case."]
        [THROW NoSuchElementException "Standard input contains fewer integers than required."]
    [END_EXCEPTION_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: If any call to input.nextInt() inside the test case loop encounters a token that is not a valid int.]
        [LOG "Reading an array size or an array element fails while processing a test case."]
        [THROW InputMismatchException "A required integer token is malformed, so the current test case cannot be completed."]
    [END_EXCEPTION_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
